name: GitHub Copilot CLI
description: Installs the GitHub Copilot CLI from GitHub releases, verified against the release's SHA256SUMS.txt, then adds marketplaces and plugins and merges settings each time the container is created.

marketplaces.description: Comma-separated marketplaces to add, as owner/repo[#ref] (GitHub) or a git URL. Empty adds none.

plugins.description: Comma-separated plugins to install for the user, as plugin@marketplace. Empty installs none.

settings.description: JSON object merged into ~/.copilot/settings.json, e.g. {'model':'claude-sonnet-5.5','footer':{'showQuota':false}}. Write its quotes as single quotes: the container CLI drops double quotes. An apostrophe inside a value is written \u0027 (\\u0027 in devcontainer.json). Empty changes nothing.
